source_evidence: Traditional IRA. Contributions typically are tax-deductible. You pay no taxes on IRA earnings until retirement, when withdrawals are taxed as income. Roth IRA. Contributions are not tax-deductible but are made with after-tax dollars.
question: Misconception: Roth IRA contributions are tax-deductible just like traditional IRA contributions.
answer: Correction: The source says traditional IRA contributions are typically tax-deductible, while Roth IRA contributions are not tax-deductible and are made with after-tax dollars.
